name: EXM_CC_TRXN_FILE_DETAILS
description: This table contains the details of processed corporate card transaction files.

columns.name: PROCESS_FILE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the upload process run on the transaction file.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: FILE_NAME
columns.description: Full name of the transaction file received from the card issuer.

columns.name: VALID_TRANSACTIONS_COUNT
columns.description: Number of transactions that were successfully processed from the transaction file.

columns.name: INVALID_TRANSACTIONS_COUNT
columns.description: Number of invalid transactions that were reported from the transaction file.

columns.name: UPLOAD_DATE
columns.description: Date and time when the transaction file was processed.

columns.name: FILE_SIZE
columns.description: Size of the transaction file processed in current upload request.

columns.name: CARD_PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the corporate card program used for processing the transaction file.

columns.name: REQUEST_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the process that was run to upload the transaction file. Valid values are Succeeded, Error, and Complete with Warnings.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
